name: Autograder Feature Showcase
description: Runnable examples of command execution, stdin, output assertions, timeouts, lifecycle hooks, and failure handling. The final test intentionally fails so the following test demonstrates `skipRemainingOnFailure`.

tests.name: Check command output
tests.description: Run one command and assert that expected text is present and unwanted text is absent.

tests.name: Pass input to a command
tests.description: Send stdin to the command and apply multiple text and regular-expression assertions to its output.

tests.name: Run a sequence of commands
tests.description: Run commands in order and check their combined stdout, including a regular-expression match.

tests.name: Use setup and teardown commands
tests.description: Create a small artifact before the test, inspect it with multiple run commands, then remove it afterward.

tests.name: Override the default timeout
tests.description: Use a short per-test timeout for a command that completes within the limit.

tests.name: Unicode support in command output
tests.description: This test demonstrates support for Unicode characters in command output.

tests.name: Expected failure: output does not contain expected text
tests.description: This test demonstrates how the autograder handles a test that fails to produce the expected output.

tests.name: Expected failure: command exits nonzero
tests.description: This final demonstration intentionally exits with an error. The runner should mark it failed and skip the next test.
$run: remaining commands after and error are skipped

tests.name: Skipped after the expected failure
tests.description: This test is not run because the previous test enables skipRemainingOnFailure.
